current_thesis: Niche fine-chemical intermediate producer with strong DATA/DMSS/DMAS/DMS profitability, high ROE, good cash conversion, clean balance sheet and aligned IPO capacity projects. The offset is material: 2026H1 profit warning, concentrated customers, export tariff exposure, related-party procurement and short listed history. At 35.71 CNY the shares are near or above base-case fair value; wait for below 30 CNY or verified Q3 recovery.
